title: Nextpower to Announce First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results on July 30, 2026
summary: Nextpower (Nasdaq: NXT) will announce its first quarter fiscal 2027 financial results after the market closes on Thursday, July 30, 2026. The company will hold a conference call to discuss the results on the same day at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time). Q1 FY2027 Earnings Call July 30, 2026 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET Live webcast available on investors.nextpower.com The webcast replay, along with supporting materials, will be available on the Nextpower IR website following the conclusion of the event. About Nextpower Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT) designs, engineers, and delivers an advanced energy technology platform for solar power plants, innovating across structural, electrical, and digital domains. Its integrated solutions streamline project execution, increase energy yield and long-term reliability, and enhance customer ROI.
